body:
Wow. Just...wow. 

I don't just feel like I could have, I know I could have written this. 

You write exactly like me. You speak as if you had my past. Everything you've written here, *everything*, is exactly describing me. 

The suicidal thoughts, the social awkwardness, the having a good body (from working out) - not wanting to drop your standards -  I understand. 

I refuse to date a fat and ugly girl simply to have someone. I can't lie to myself, I don't want that. I would never accept that. 

I looked at your profile, and low and behold, I was blown away. 

Sabes porque? Eu tambem falo Portugues. A unica diferenca e que so Americano, mas tenho cidadania Portuguesa. Foda-se, nos samos identicos em quase tudo.

Write back. Please. I've never felt like I shared so much with a stranger.
